remarks: Sun pours into this renovated one bedroom, one full and one half bath in a fabulous doorman building in the heart of downtown Greenwich! Beautiful kitchen with marble counter tops and stainless steel appliances, including a wine refrigerator. Spacious primary bedroom with walk-in closet. Hardwood floors throughout, coffered ceilings and large windows with views of the Long Island Sound. Stackable w/d in unit. Reserved indoor garage parking spot and spacious storage bin. Heat and hot water included. Seconds to shops, restaurants, ferry for Island Beach, train and I 95 for an easy ride into NYC! This one has it all!
